cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The artifact validator resolves and probes a path before hashing that path, so a controlled replacement with a run-root-external symlink after the legacy path probe is accepted when the external bytes match the indexed digest.
impact: The TOCTOU repository-to-HTTP probe fails before the secure descriptor-based validator is implemented; existing non-race symlink and canonical formal_output behavior remain covered.
lesson: Open each bounded artifact path relative to a no-follow run-root descriptor and hash the same descriptor after regular-file fstat.

cause: A retrospective search command placed backtick syntax inside a double-quoted shell argument, so the shell attempted command substitution and the search command did not run.
impact: No product, test, root, or other-worktree files were changed; the intended retrospective state was verified by a safe search afterward.
lesson: Use single-quoted shell patterns for retrospective searches and inspect command substitution hazards before execution.

cause: The explicit compatibility artifact-type vocabulary can drift as producers evolve; widening it in this remediation would add unsourced constants outside the TOCTOU safety boundary.
impact: Bounded P2 follow-up: perform a producer-vocabulary drift audit or establish a server-owned registry in a separately scoped line; remediation-13 adds no artifact-type constants.
lesson: Treat artifact-type allowlist drift as a separately evidenced compatibility review rather than copying more producer constants into a security validator.

cause: The artifact validator now applies a bounded server-owned path grammar, no-follow descriptor traversal, regular-file fstat, and SHA-256 reads from the same opened descriptor.
impact: The focused repository-to-HTTP artifact contract passes 90 tests; the explicit TOCTOU, non-race symlink, unreadable probe, real digest, missing file, and canonical formal_output probes pass with typed HTTP errors and no groups.
lesson: Hash the descriptor that was safely opened and fstat as a regular file; never validate one pathname and hash another lookup.

cause: The existing classification production bindings and typed consumer contracts remain intact after the descriptor-based repository validator change.

lesson: Keep repository integrity enforcement below the typed classification producer and consumer contracts, then rerun both seams.
